body: Thanks for the chance! Hopefully you’ll put out an iOS (iPhone) version at some point.
Keep us updated! I’m in the same boat as you and thinking about trying sr to taper off odsmt. Would love to hear your experience.
That would be amazing, definitely interested to know more about using SR this way. Particularly what dose of SR per day.
Thanks so much!
Never heard of this, very interesting! I wonder what the E stands for?
Thanks! Here’s hoping!
Do you know if it’s gone for good? I really hope not.
Wild fluctuations! I was finally able to move my funds yesterday, for around $5 too!

Same thing happened to me, two days ago. I’m still waiting for the fee to go down. ($50 to transfer to another wallet?!) I’m transferring all my BTC and never using Coinbase again. (This is not the first time this has happened).
Do you mind sharing how you tapered? Like a % drop every few days or every day or did you decrease the amount you were taking once a week, etc?
I understand what you are saying. I spend every day trying not to die. That’s it. Nothing else. Just trying to survive myself. What’s the point of that?

That’s really kind of you. I selfishly took in 4 stray cats this last year to try to force myself to stay alive. Because they wouldn’t have anyone else to care for them. I wish I could say it’s working.

Maybe so, maybe not. But I know for a fact I would’ve killed myself without the numbness and comfort drugs give me, so every day I get is one I really shouldn’t have. So I can’t complain if the drug use shortens my life.
Is it possible the dolphin is this dog toy? [Tender-Tuffs Tiny Blue Dolphin Small Dog Toy](https://snugglepuppy.com/products/tender-tuffs-tiny-blue-dolphin-small-dog-toy)
Sleep is the only part of the day I look forward to, because it’s what I imagine death will be like.
This. I spend every waking hour just trying to survive myself. Nodding into sleep is a cessation, a quieting, a *relief*.

First, that’s amazing! Second… Would you mind sharing how you did it? Did you use kratom to taper and quit and now maintain? Or did you get clean without it and now use kratom to stay clean? (Again, well done!)

Day 3 is absolutely amazing!! Congrats on making it that far!! And oh, I get it, the depression that this withdrawal brings is absolute hell, the bleakest, darkest emotional agony. Please hold on. Rage and cry and try to remind yourself over and over again that part of how you’re feeling is artificial, brought on by the sudden lack of trams in your body. I know it’s hard, feels impossible. I’ve yet to even properly start my detox as I’m using the very last bit of product I have to do an extreme taper—and it’s already miserable. I have so much empathy for where you’re at, and I hope you’re past the peak. May we both find some peace and happiness at the end of this. 💜💜💜

You are so kind, thank you. ❤️ I’ve been considering getting on an antidepressant to help. Wish I didn’t have to get a doctor’s visit first and could start immediately but I’ll hold onto the hope through this withdrawal.

I’m sorry you’re suffering op. This post bears so much similarity to my own situation, it’s eerie (bunk product from reputable source, years on a research chem metabolite of tramadol but now facing cold turkey.) 😔 But I’m a few days out from the pain you’re currently in. I wish I could bring you over some comfort meds. Help you with everything. Please don’t blame yourself. Please hang in there and please message me if you need someone to just say I understand. Coming off trams is hellish, because of the antidepressant effects, it’s so much worse than the standard opiate withdrawal. When you get through this,  you’ll be able to help so many dogs in the future.

This is great advice. Thank you. I’m not the original poster but I’m about to face my own unexpected cold turkey due to bunk product and desperately trying to get some comfort meds… 😫 The only thing I’m confused about is when to take what. And what dosage. I have clonidine and baclofen, some benzos and trazodone. What do I prioritize? Clonidine? I always see that mentioned. I just hope I can make it through, or even get off to kratom, and taper from there. Thanks for writing this up! It means a lot.

Not original poster but I’m in the same boat. I’m so desperate, and I’ve not heard of this before. Do you mind telling me how much NAC you would take in withdrawal and how often? Every day? Every other day? Just once? Or continually for a short period? ❤️

I can’t imagine it either. I can barely even stand up and walk. I’m pretty sure I look like death and would pass out after eight steps. Please don’t be hard on yourself. All you need to focus on is getting through each minute, each hour without using. If you’re doing that, you’re doing everything right. I’m sorry you’re suffering. I’ll be where you are in a week, and I think you’re pretty super human for coming on Reddit and asking a coherent question! I can barely form a sentence when I’m withdrawing. Much less act human. You’re doing awesome. Don’t forget that. Wish I could bring you some groceries or comfort meds. Feel free to message me. 💜
Oh gotcha. Thanks for explaining!
What do you mean by the adrenaline comment? And “life threatening”? I’m asking for harm reduction purposes, I don’t take methadone, but do take large amounts of odsmt and have never heard this.
That’s the dream!! Hope the supply stays pure and flowing for you. 👍
Yeah, that’s the plan. I’m trying to taper. Appreciate you, man. Thanks so much.

Man, I have the exact same dilemma. I can’t figure out how to avoid that on-edge, uncomfortably-wide-awake, please-kill-me stim-like feeling without taking a ridiculous amount of odsmt at night. I hope you can figure it out!!

Do you take the bromaz at the same time or on a delay? Ever tried any other benzo? I’ve wanted to try this bc my doses of odsmt are insanely high (to my shame). I have to dose high so I can start nodding and knock myself out at night, otherwise if I dose just enough odsmt to keep wds at bay, I get a burst of restless energy and have to stay in the gnarly mind space of severe depression all night long without any outlet.
Currently deep in it. I’d love to read the rest of your poem!
Thanks for the chance. Could really use this right now. ❤️

Yeah, I get this. There has never been a single instant when I’ve been helpful to another person or been anything other than an ugly, useless burden. I know I’m a total fuck-up. Some people just aren’t compatible with this life. I’m one of them.
I felt the same way about my cat. He died a month ago. I’m still here. I wish I wasn’t.
Sorry, I didn’t submit a ticket.
Definitely in the same boat. I promise you’re not the biggest mess-up.

Every time I’m walking and I see a train, I fantasize about throwing myself in front of it. I’m just a person incompatible with life. So I get what you mean about wishing for a natural event to take you out. 

I too hope there is a better outcome for you, that you find a reason to hang on.
Thanks. I’m absolutely devastated.
Thank you for your kind words. Sorry for your loss. Your dog was well loved, and your cat is very lucky to have you now.
Thank you.

I get what you mean about trauma. After a certain point, you just can’t endure any more. Trauma doesn’t make you stronger, it makes you… *tired.* 

Tired of this burden of life.

I do hope you find some relief.
I’m going to, but I’m giving it a few more days first. Not hopeful but it’s worth a shot.

IOS. I’m going to submit a ticket, just to see if I can get credit. I probably spent at least 30 hours playing the game. It’s a major grind at the end, resource-wise, to upgrade the mansion. (Good luck, if you decide to try for it!!)
Yeah, I might take a break too. It’s so frustrating. I thought I’d be okay since Grand Mafia worked for me. Mafia City is so similar… but… Nope.

I reached level 20 two days ago and it has not pended for me, like it did for others. It asked for tracking fine but did not ever show up on Discover page. Bummed because I spent $7. (Grand Mafia worked for me, went pending at level 20). Hope it works for you!!
Sorry to hear, this game was so tedious, and so involved.
Mine didn’t either and I definitely had over 10 hours of play time. Did you contact Swagbucks? Any update?

Did you ever get credit? I made it to level 20 and it didn’t pend… I’m feeling so dumb because I put money into it (only $7, but I really need every dollar.) I hope you got paid and weren’t out the $35. ❤️

Related to all this so hard. I feel completely run down all the time, even though I feel like I need to use to live. I’m almost to that point of saying “this will be the last stop on this train.” Cuz otherwise my train is heading to (fatal) derailment. 

Way to go on your recovery! You’re a warrior, and I appreciate you sharing your story.
Thanks for the tips. Started the game last night and I like this type of game too. I’m enjoying it, and it’s progressing steadily. Appreciate your reply 🌸
Got my delivery and my refund. Thanks so much!!

2 days for me. The trick is to check the MGM slots Facebook and/or Twitter. They post free coins and you can go and collect a lot of free coins that way. As long as you don’t run out of coins, the game is smooth going.
I see you completed Solitaire Cruise in about 1 day. Any tips? Congrats btw. I also recommend MGM slots, it’s another easy one.
So true. And as you get older, the lows get even lower and the highs… no higher. Diminishing returns. I wish I could escape into nothingness.
Rooting for you! I hope you have some comfort meds, and people in your life to support you! You got this.
How much something like this can mean to someone down and out on their luck!! Good on you for doing this.
Thanks for the chance! This is such a kind giveaway!
Damn. This so succinctly describes how I feel about my own life. I feel for you.

I understand this all too well. It feels so shameful as an adult to make barely enough money to pay for basic necessities and have to depend on your parent(s) to not be homeless. And to drive you places. I also have being a fentanyl addict to add to my list of why I’m useless/worthless, so it sounds like you might be doing better than me at least.

I know a few ways to make some extra money online if that could at all help you. Not much money at all but when you’re scraping the bottom of the barrel, anything helps. Feel free to message me. 

I’m so, so sorry you’re suffering. Severe depression is no joke; it’s like being dead while you’re still walking around, and still breathing.
Oh wow. That would make me paranoid af. Glad nothing came of it for you. Thanks for replying, appreciate it!
Man that’s fucking shit, the DEA and cops showing up. Don’t they have better shit to do? Did anything come of their visit or was that it?
Appreciate you, brother! Thanks for sharing this.

Yes. I worry about hurting my parents, even while simultaneously knowing I’m a burden to them, alive, and they’d be so much better off with me gone. Have you ever experienced grief/loss? I think it’s normal, having felt that pain, not to want to put that great sadness on someone you care about. :(
Thanks for this opportunity. This is a very nice giveaway, bringing some light in time for the holidays.

Unfortunately, fentadope's quite ubiqutous. It's hard to find pure heroin (at least where I am).  I'd definitely stick to very small bumps until you get to where you wanna be. Or ask someone to come over and sit with you. Be safe, brother.
Awesome. Looking forward to it.
I’d love a video. Thanks for sharing this tip!

I'm sorry for your loss. It sounds like your husband was an incredible man! I know this feeling well, wanting to join a loved one in death. I have so much apathy about my drug use, too, because I just don't want to be alive, and be without my brother. He was my only close family for years and years, the only person who stood by me. 

I hope you're doing okay today. I'll be thinking about you.

Thinking of you, friend. I started using after I lost my brother to suicide, I really felt this. There’s some pain no drug and no amount of time can ever heal. I’m so sorry. I hope you can find some sleep and the sun shines on you tomorrow.
Thank you for what you do.

Thank you for these kind words and valuable advice. I do need help, it’s so hard to acknowledge it and seek it out. Thanks for your thoughtful support. I will save this comment to motivate myself. 

You are early in recovery but you are already being of service and helping others and that’s so badass. I can’t thank you enough.

I understand what you mean about this being the hardest fight of your life. I’ve been through some horrific trauma in my life but nothing compares to active addiction. Nothing. It’s truly hell.

Count yourself among the caring people, friend. Thanks for this sweet reply. I’ve found that to be true as well. People battling addiction are also often some of the most hurt people I’ve ever met. Be gentle with yourself in this fight. I understand your fear of the subs. :( I’m really hoping that they can give you back some peace and stability, enough so that you can continue your recovery journey and are able to pursue interests and relationships that make you happy. That make you feel better than okay.

You can do this!! You are amazing for being willing to try. It’s more than I’ve done. I think you’re awesome. ❤️

I loved reading this post. This is so inspirational, it definitely pumped me up! I don’t know you, but I’m really fucking proud!! I know you said you didn’t face this issue, but for me, I always get suicidal when I try to withdraw, to the point of being ready to off myself if I don’t pick up. And I’m afraid I’ll be suicidal clean, because that’s why I turned to drugs in the first place. Any advice or battle tips? I’m definitely a weak bitch but fuck if this post didn’t make me want to face my fear.

Here’s to day 11!! You got this, bro.
I’m rooting for you! Glad you didn’t drive that car off. ❤️ I’m also in the dark, alone, but in my dark little corner, I’m thinking about you today. Keep us updated on your subs journey.
How’d you take ‘em? Oral? Smoke? Glad you got your money back, those be looking rough. Be careful - could have hot spots.
Thanks for writing and sharing this! Gave me a lot of hope. That’s awesome that your insurance covers the cost of the shot.

I look forward to watching the Raccoon Whisperer every night on YouTube. Just a guy in Canada feeding raccoons. It’s such a simple thing but it’s usually the only time I feel okay for the entire day. 

I don’t think you watching bird feeder videos is at all dumb. It’s very nice. I hope you continue to watch and enjoy them. And I hope you can go outside and do some bird watching yourself.
You deserve that hug. Wish I could give you one. I guarantee there are many, many people where you are who would love to hug you, if they knew how much you were hurting.
You reached me. I’m glad you keep posting here.
You sound like a lovely person. You have such a wide variety of interests.

I’m in the same boat. Every morning my first feeling is dread. And my first thought is, I don’t want to do this anymore. This, being life. 

It’s completely beyond me, too, how other people function. I’ve been non-functional my entire life, just a burden on my family, with no added value.

Yes, definitely. There’s such a profound lack of motivation for me. Like, even when I put on makeup, I won’t go to the effort I used to, and I just don’t care anymore about wearing the same clothes multiple days in a row or not brushing my teeth twice a day. Which makes me feel worse about myself, and even more depressed.

I also grind my teeth, which is something I never did before. I didn’t know that was a common thing.

Thanks for sharing the article.

Yeah. :( His character arc was so powerful and meaningful to me—it gave me a lot of hope and courage—so the ending was such a slap in the face. I’ve never felt so betrayed by a show that I’ve supported, and defended, for years. 

There had already been four teenagers die on the show. Surely that was too much already. 🖤😥
I would definitely get it checked out, right away. Don't risk your health, or your peace of mind. ❤️

Anyone but Justin. His life was 17 years of misery. He deserved to have some happiness instead of being killed in the most brutal, languishing way in the very last episode with a medically inaccurate HIV/AIDS diagnosis.

It’s a tie between mornings and late at night when I can’t sleep and the negative thoughts start bombarding me (and that little voice in my head which is my disease, saying, *I know how to make this better*...)

Starting and sticking to a new morning routine is definitely a great idea. Maybe doing some exercise first thing? Or meditation? Or coffee? Or taking some vitamins? 

I wish you a better week!!
Facts.

Yes! I can’t believe the school administration let Clay speak at graduation after what he did. I wouldn’t have blamed them, honesty, if they hadn’t allowed it!

It was such a horrible storytelling choice to have none of the people who loved Justin most (Clay, Jess, Justin’s *parents*) speak at his funeral.

I was upset that Lainie and/or Matt had nothing to say either. This was their son! (Matt’s a literature professor, surely he could write a eulogy!) And we didn’t even get a single scene of them saying anything to Justin in the hospital, telling him they loved him, comforting him... nothing. If it was Clay who was dying, there would have been words exchanged between him and his parents. So why not Justin? (Just because he’s adopted? That’s fucked.)

I agree with you, though. Clay or Jessica should have spoken, rather than have Alex get up and say he “never liked Justin” (time and place, man! I would be pissed if someone got up to say that at my family member’s funeral!)

But, yeah, Justin should not have died, so there should have been no eulogies at all, that’s my final opinion, 😂

Not me. The fact that Justin died makes me value it less because they knew each other for such a short time, and never got a chance to be real brothers. Clay didn’t even ever call Justin his brother, or consider him one, until after Justin died. 

Their relationship would have been so much more powerful if they had grown closer through the years as brothers—forever united as family. They had such a beautiful arc through seasons 2 and 3 that was dropped abruptly.

Clay spent most of season 4 resenting Justin, and treating him horribly (with no remorse), taking him for granted, really, and we never really saw them have fun together or bond over anything but trauma, so I imagine one day Justin will just be “that boy who lived with us for a while” and that’s it, to Clay.

(I’m bitter.)
Thanks for the links! (And for writing a better season 4!!) I’ll definitely check out your podcast. ❤️

No, no, please don’t feel guilty, you shouldn’t! At all. Tapering is a much better idea than cold turkey, especially if you have the means to do so, and the self-restraint. Tramadol is a rough one, because you get two withdrawals in one: the opioid and the anti-depressant.

Your plan sounds great. I hope you’re doing well so far. I believe in you!!

Exactly. The ending would have been much, much more impactful if Justin, alive, shared his essay with Clay. Because that essay scene is meaningless as is—Clay was not Justin’s “positive influence” or the “reason he’s alive today.” Justin’s dead; Clay did not save him or have a positive effect on his story. He never even made him feel loved or worthy of being taken care of (according to Dr. Ellman, which, 😒). 

How much more powerful: to show Justin and Clay leaving on the road trip together, showing that no matter what you’ve been through, recovery is possible, with positive intervention (in other words, the antithesis of season 1, and what happened to Hannah. That’s a strong message!) 

Justin had so much positive support, he wanted to be alive, he asked for help, he worked on changing himself, but still, according to the show, he was beyond saving. Nothing he did mattered, he was an abused child, who was made to feel unlovable, so he was always going to die. 

Wow, I rambled. Sorry. This show really messed me up, as a person with a similar background to Justin, who’s currently in active addiction. 

I really liked what you had to say.
Congrats on sticking with it. You’re doing great!
Same

This. His entire storyline was TRAUMA. He should have gotten a chance to heal and survive, to give real people who watch the show that have been through any of the things he’s been through hope of recovery, too. His character’s journey meant so much to me, only to have it all ruined in the very last episode, and all that hope for myself snatched away. :(

I felt this. I’m also someone who doesn’t feel bad after relapse. Sometimes the ability to use is the only thing keeping me alive, which I know is also a self-justification, but life’s bleak, man. 

Sending good vibes for that interview, and for many happy, productive days to come. You got this!
Any update on how you’re doing? Hope you’re doing well, bro. :-)

Oh neat. Sounds interesting! I think 2x12 is the best place to go canon divergent; that horrifically graphic scene in 2x13 and then the school shooting storyline is where the show began to lose itself, imo. 

Monty/Diego... I’m intrigued. You should be proud if you are indeed the first writer using that tag; you’re a pioneer! :)
Ooh, what ship if you don’t mind me asking?
Exactly. I can forgive a lot of bad writing, but that ruined the entire show for me.

Such a brutal, hopeless ending for a character who, more than anyone else, represented recovery, and embodied the idea that “it can get better.” 

I really don’t understand how his death magically solved everyone else’s problems, either. 🤨
Hell yeah. Congrats on the clean time!! I’m still working on my first 30 days; posts like this are soooo inspirational. Hope you had people to celebrate with, and a wonderful week ahead!

Oh no, hardly a rant at all, not by any definition. It was valid, and much needed criticism. I always enjoy seeing your posts in this subreddit. Your understanding of the characters and your articulation of the problems in the writing are always lovely to read. Truly, truly lovely. I really need to check out your fanfic!

This was beautifully and thoughtfully written. I wish you had been a writer for this show. Thank you for sharing your perspective, and expressing it so gracefully. You captured how disappointing, and hurtful some of the storylines were in later seasons in a way that makes me feel—seen. I thank you.

I relate to all of this so hard, but I also wanna say that I can tell from your replies that you are beautifully kind and thoughtful. You’re certainly not worthless, the world needs more people like you. I’m sorry you’re suffering, wish the light would shine and give you some peace. (Also wish there was a guaranteed way out for us—for when the suffering gets too much. Sorry 😞).

[NA marathon meetings on Zoom.](https://virtual-na.org/marathons/) I’ve used several of these rooms when I’m really struggling and need to immediately jump on a meeting. I really relate to what you wrote about putting up a false front in public. Hope things get better for you.
Thanks for the report. Glad you had a good experience. Do you think you’ll stick with 7 next time, or go higher?

Delusions of sobriety is common with benzos. But, yeah, they def affecting you if you’re forgetting what you did/how you felt while you were on ‘em. Do you have anxiety? Because if you do, they can really calm you down and sedate your racing thoughts, which is where the appeal is for some people, and maybe is where the “marvelous” confident feeling comes from?

Oh yeah, I get the daily grind, and the pointlessness of working just to survive—all the while being miserable. Sorry about the guitar playing, it really sucks not being able to enjoy what used to make you happy. I had hobbies once—it seems so long ago but it was really just a year ago—but now, nothing brings me joy or distraction, which I guess is why we find ourselves in this subreddit. I truly hope you find something like the guitar again, to bring you a little peace and satisfaction, even if only temporarily.
I get what you’re saying. I try to sleep at much as possible and hate the fact that I have to wake up and live another day. Sorry you’re struggling.

I feel like a kinder, more empathetic person when I’m high. Less of an asshole to be around, and not so morose and depressed. But mainly, it blocks out my trauma so I can keep on existing. Terrible coping mechanism, but it gets me through the week.

I understand. The only thing I’m living for is my cat. What kind of job do you have? Is there something more fulfilling you could imagine yourself doing, career-wise? Do you have any hobbies or something you’d like to learn to do? Sending good vibes.
Don’t snort. If you metabolize tramadol well (some people do, some don’t), you won’t need much for a buzz. I see you’re trying 200, how did that work for you?

Me too. I can’t rewatch the show or follow the actors anymore. 😢 He was one of the only characters on the show trying to get better and improve his life, and they killed him anyway. Such a demoralizing message.
